tool_result_transport.content: one concise text summary for the calling Agent
tool_result_transport.structuredContent: one acs-mcp-result/3 success or problem envelope
tool_result_transport.isError: false for accepted observations and state transitions; true for rejected or failed tool execution

read_profile.title: Read connection profile
read_profile.description: Read trusted subject, tenant, access_mode, client Profile view, connection state and applicable OAuth scope summary. Owner identity remains active until explicit revocation; shared deployments report their configured governance.
read_profile.selection_guidance: Use at the start of a global or web session.

list_projects.title: List accessible projects
list_projects.description: List active Projects visible to the authenticated tenant and service context with stable Project IDs, Root handles and lifecycle summaries.
list_projects.selection_guidance: Use when project_id is unknown or more than one project is involved.

list_connections.title: List ACS connections
list_connections.description: List registered Node, Tunnel, Source Provider and remote MCP paths. Owner registration persists through disconnect; remote execution verifies the actual TLS-bound target, process and Session readiness.
list_connections.selection_guidance: Use to inspect local, web and source access paths.

load_project.title: Load project context
load_project.description: Load authorized Project identity, current management files, Routes and knowledge from the selected machine. Recorded Source readers require an explicit source and revision; communication history uses list_messages.
load_project.selection_guidance: Load authorized Project identity, current management files, Routes and knowledge from the selected machine. Recorded Source readers require an explicit source and revision; communication history uses list_messages.

list_routes.title: List project routes
list_routes.description: List registered development Routes with lifecycle, Scope, goal and source-state hints.
list_routes.selection_guidance: List registered development Routes with lifecycle, Scope, goal and source-state hints.

list_collaborators.title: List Collaborators
list_collaborators.description: Find authorized contacts and your own stable address. Names and roles help select a recipient; use collaborator_handle directly as send_message.to. Optional filters narrow visibility.
list_collaborators.selection_guidance: Find authorized contacts and your own stable address. Names and roles help select a recipient; use collaborator_handle directly as send_message.to. Optional filters narrow visibility.

list_harnesses.title: List Harnesses
list_harnesses.description: Read current registered receiving locations and observed Native Session state. Defaults to authorized project locations. unknown is not idle. This query never prepares, starts, resumes or invokes a Harness. Configuration is a separate authorized action.
list_harnesses.selection_guidance: Read current registered receiving locations and observed Native Session state. Defaults to authorized project locations. unknown is not idle. This query never prepares, starts, resumes or invokes a Harness. Configuration is a separate authorized action.

list_sources.title: List project sources
list_sources.description: Discover project repository and source-location hints, recorded version observations and available provider capabilities. Agents choose an available source reader and record the version actually read.
list_sources.selection_guidance: Use before source reads or provider selection.

list_activity.title: List Activity
list_activity.description: List bounded Project/Route/configuration events and communication events visible to your identity. Private message activity is limited to its actual participants. Use next_cursor for continuation.
list_activity.selection_guidance: List bounded Project/Route/configuration events and communication events visible to your identity. Private message activity is limited to its actual participants. Use next_cursor for continuation.

read_resource.title: Read Resource
read_resource.description: Read current Project or Route metadata and captured source Artifacts at a requested revision. Communication handles use the same permission checks as read_message. Message history is available through list_messages.
read_resource.selection_guidance: Read current Project or Route metadata and captured source Artifacts at a requested revision. Communication handles use the same permission checks as read_message. Message history is available through list_messages.

handle.description: A Project, Route, source Artifact or communication handle returned by ACS.

read_message.title: Read Message
read_message.description: Read permitted original content, relationships and the first explicit Agent reply. Also accepts notification_handle to read an ACS system notification and its own Native delivery state. Reading preserves Inbox and history. The original and embedded first reply each obey max_inline_bytes; follow returned read_message actions using that body's handle and next_offset. Native output is not a reply.
read_message.selection_guidance: Read permitted original content, relationships and the first explicit Agent reply. Also accepts notification_handle to read an ACS system notification and its own Native delivery state. Reading preserves Inbox and history. The original and embedded first reply each obey max_inline_bytes; follow returned read_message actions using that body's handle and next_offset. Native output is not a reply.

handle.description: A message_handle, response_handle or notification_handle returned by ACS.

max_inline_bytes.description: Byte budget for each original and embedded reply body. Follow returned read_message continuations for either body.

check_inbox.title: Check Inbox
check_inbox.description: List messages addressed to your authenticated identity without consuming them. Read content with read_message; reply using send_message with from as to and message_handle in reply_to. notifications lists ACS system notices: pass notification_handle to read_message. with filters peer addresses, not notification handles. next_cursor continues the page; resume_cursor discovers later messages.
check_inbox.selection_guidance: List messages addressed to your authenticated identity without consuming them. Read content with read_message; reply using send_message with from as to and message_handle in reply_to. notifications lists ACS system notices: pass notification_handle to read_message. with filters peer addresses, not notification handles. next_cursor continues the page; resume_cursor discovers later messages.

with.description: Filter by a peer's collaborator_handle or Client address; use read_message for notification handles.

list_files.title: List source files
list_files.description: List source files. Owner omission selects the project's current primary worktree; optional source_id/source_root selects a readable location and revision selects a captured snapshot. Continue pagination at its returned revision.
list_files.selection_guidance: Use for directory discovery from web or local management sessions.

search_files.title: Search source files
search_files.description: Search source paths or content. Owner omission searches the current primary worktree; optional source_id/source_root selects a readable location and revision selects a captured snapshot.
search_files.selection_guidance: Use when a target path or content location is unknown.

read_file.title: Read source file
read_file.description: Read source content. Owner omission selects the project's current primary worktree; source_id or source_root can select another readable location. A supplied revision selects a captured snapshot. Report the actual version with the content.
read_file.selection_guidance: Use after context loading, file listing or search.

read_source.title: Read source state
read_source.description: Read actual branch, commit, tree and workspace state with advisory version and location guidance. Owner omission selects the current primary worktree; source_id/source_root or a captured revision is an explicit reader choice.
read_source.selection_guidance: Use before source-dependent delegation, review, handoff or acceptance.

read_diff.title: Read source diff
read_diff.description: Read a bounded diff between two exact commit or workspace view revisions in one SourceBinding.
read_diff.selection_guidance: Use for engineering review, architecture impact analysis and acceptance.

create_route.title: Create development Route
create_route.description: Create one long-lived Route and Route Scope under an existing project Root.
create_route.selection_guidance: Use for a new durable development line.

update_route.title: Update development Route
update_route.description: Apply one versioned lifecycle or management-metadata change to an existing Route. A context_manifest change requires direct identity readback from an admitted Source snapshot in the same Route Scope.
update_route.selection_guidance: Use for lifecycle, goal-summary or display changes.

configure_team.title: Configure Team
configure_team.description: Add or partially update stable collaborators in the current authorized scope. Only specified members and fields change. Existing members remain. For a new member provide agent_slot_id and principal_ref; role/profile and Harness preferences are optional. Names never change historical authors. if_unchanged detects conflicting property edits. Native preparation retains the committed receiving location and binding version; a later receiving change reports configuration_changed without claiming a current Session. Native state is separate from committed configuration; credentials and Native IDs are not inferred from message text.
configure_team.selection_guidance: Add or partially update stable collaborators in the current authorized scope. Only specified members and fields change. Existing members remain. For a new member provide agent_slot_id and principal_ref; role/profile and Harness preferences are optional. Names never change historical authors. if_unchanged detects conflicting property edits. Native preparation retains the committed receiving location and binding version; a later receiving change reports configuration_changed without claiming a current Session. Native state is separate from committed configuration; credentials and Native IDs are not inferred from message text.

expected_revision.description: Optional team_revision for the selected Scope, independent of Root/Route revisions. Omit for partial merging; use member.if_unchanged for observed-property conflicts.

send_message.title: Send Message
send_message.description: Send natural content from your authenticated identity to a collaborator. Use this tool for replies, corrections and handoffs; reply_to names original messages from the same peer addressed to you. A delegation to another collaborator is a new message; put background context in content, not reply_to. Defaults to invoke + async. sync waits for the recipient's first explicit reply, including clarification. message_only does not wake the recipient. Timeout leaves communication intact. Reuse client_request_id for the same send's retry; intentional identical sends use different IDs.
send_message.selection_guidance: Send natural content from your authenticated identity to a collaborator. Use this tool for replies, corrections and handoffs; reply_to names original messages from the same peer addressed to you. A delegation to another collaborator is a new message; put background context in content, not reply_to. Defaults to invoke + async. sync waits for the recipient's first explicit reply, including clarification. message_only does not wake the recipient. Timeout leaves communication intact. Reuse client_request_id for the same send's retry; intentional identical sends use different IDs.

wait_for_response.title: Wait For Response
wait_for_response.description: Observe original sent message or response handles without sending or invoking again. Defaults to all and the actual recipient's first explicit reply. any returns when one has replied. timeout_seconds bounds this observation only; repeat after reconnecting to obtain the same first reply. Large bodies remain bounded; use returned read_message continuations to read further without sending again.
wait_for_response.selection_guidance: Observe original sent message or response handles without sending or invoking again. Defaults to all and the actual recipient's first explicit reply. any returns when one has replied. timeout_seconds bounds this observation only; repeat after reconnecting to obtain the same first reply. Large bodies remain bounded; use returned read_message continuations to read further without sending again.

apply_patch.title: Apply source patch
apply_patch.description: Apply one structured patch to an authorized isolated SourceBinding workspace at an exact tree.
apply_patch.selection_guidance: Use only with Source write capability.

read_source_file.title: Read Source File
read_source_file.description: Read explicitly selected Source content and captured versions. Read source content. Owner omission selects the project's current primary worktree; source_id or source_root can select another readable location. A supplied revision selects a captured snapshot. Report the actual version with the content.
read_source_file.selection_guidance: Use after context loading, file listing or search.

list_source_files.title: List Source Files
list_source_files.description: Read explicitly selected Source content and captured versions. List source files. Owner omission selects the project's current primary worktree; optional source_id/source_root selects a readable location and revision selects a captured snapshot. Continue pagination at its returned revision.
list_source_files.selection_guidance: Use for directory discovery from web or local management sessions.

search_source_files.title: Search Source Files
search_source_files.description: Read explicitly selected Source content and captured versions. Search source paths or content. Owner omission searches the current primary worktree; optional source_id/source_root selects a readable location and revision selects a captured snapshot.
search_source_files.selection_guidance: Use when a target path or content location is unknown.

list_messages.title: List Messages
list_messages.description: Find your incoming and outgoing history. Optional with and direction narrow results. Stable cursors follow authority commit order, not UUID or sender clocks.
list_messages.selection_guidance: Find your incoming and outgoing history. Optional with and direction narrow results. Stable cursors follow authority commit order, not UUID or sender clocks.

with.description: Filter by a peer's collaborator_handle or Client address; use read_message for notification handles.

configure_project.title: Configure project management files
configure_project.description: Set, replace or clear the current machine and management document location of a Project. Agents select source versions explicitly for their work.
configure_project.selection_guidance: Use to maintain the current Project management file location.

configure_root.title: Configure Root
configure_root.description: Establish, adopt or configure one Root and its communication namespace using the Owner service. A trusted Client can establish a new Root; a bound Root Manager configures its existing authorized Root. project_id is the namespace key, not a second management lifecycle. On first setup provide changes.name; root_id defaults to project_id. Optional manager configures the real Root collaborator through the same operation. Native preparation reports actual availability separately; no Client Slot or Session is synthesized.
configure_root.selection_guidance: Establish, adopt or configure one Root and its communication namespace using the Owner service. A trusted Client can establish a new Root; a bound Root Manager configures its existing authorized Root. project_id is the namespace key, not a second management lifecycle. On first setup provide changes.name; root_id defaults to project_id. Optional manager configures the real Root collaborator through the same operation. Native preparation reports actual availability separately; no Client Slot or Session is synthesized.

owner.authorization: trusted Client or bound Slot; live identity and project checks

shared.authorization: trusted caller binding and scoped, live Grants
